title: CompanionRequest
description: Append-only log of every companion AI request. Never mutated. Retries are new rows. No message body stored.

user_id.description: Scoped to authenticated user. RLS enforced. Cascade-deleted on account deletion.

tenant_id.description: Tenant boundary. Required for isolation. Never null.

session_id.description: Groups requests within a single conversation session.

model_used.description: Provider model identifier, e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022.

model_version.description: Pinned model version string. Tracks drift across provider updates.

request_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when request left the server.

response_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when response was received or fallback triggered.

latency_ms.description: Total round-trip latency in milliseconds. For fallbacks, latency to failure + fallback resolution time.

token_input.description: Input tokens consumed. 0 for ghost fallbacks.

token_output.description: Output tokens generated. 0 for ghost fallbacks.

success.description: True if model returned a valid response. False on any error, timeout, or fallback.

is_fallback.description: True if a ghost offline fallback response was served instead of a live model response.

fallback_reason.description: Reason fallback was triggered. Null when is_fallback is false.

error_code.description: Provider HTTP status or error code string. Null on success.

user_visible_latency_ms.description: Latency as perceived by the client (includes streaming first-token or fallback trigger). Optional.
